d: ‘The Burning Ghat’ is Rishab Rikhiram Sharma’s heartfelt tribute to the eternal flame of Manikarnika Ghat in Varanasi - a sacred site where the cycle of life ends and the soul finds Moksh (liberation). This evocative soundscape blends traditional Indian instruments with electronic synths, symbolizing the bridge between the ancient and the new. Inspired by his journey to Burning Man in the US — where a ceremonial fire marks the end of the festival, releasing emotions and grief — this composition channels the transformative power of fire, both spiritual and symbolic.
